chunks: And in it, he (peace be upon him) said: Indeed, Allah, the Exalted, is not unjust to His servants in the distribution of the khums.
But He places in it something of deception and trickery.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of ghurur in the distribution of khums according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifying that the divine command of khums is not inherently unjust but serves as a spiritual test of 'ghurur' (subtle deception or purification) for the believer. This perspective highlights the transition from the general distribution of war spoils to the specific, enduring fiscal obligation supporting the Imams and the poor, emphasizing trust in divine wisdom over immediate material perception.
